newsitem.title: USA: Alico could post gain from land option.
newsitem.headline: Alico could post gain from land option.

text.p: Alico Inc said on Tuesday that it could post a pre-tax gain of $8.5 million to $24.5 million if a shopping mall developer exercises an option to acquire the company's property near Florida Gulf Coast University.
Florida Gulf Coast University is expected to open this fall, the company said.
The size of the gain would depend upon the time and the amount of property acquired, Alico said.

The Richard E. Jacobs Group Inc is proposing to build the shopping center near Interstate 75, Alico said. The option agreement permits the acquisition of a minimum of 150 acres and a maximum of 400 acres on the site, Alico said.
